# Containers & Layouts shows seven layouts side by side, and the cube

## Context

#21140's target gives the Containers & Layouts group two cards at the Engine 14 cut: **＋ Layouts side by side** ("the same six items under fit, hbox, vbox, flexbox, grid, card and cube, with align, pack and flex as controls") and **✓ `layout/cube`** ("a card: nothing else shows it"). The band (Trees, Tabs, Containers & Layouts, Dashboard & Docking, Drag & Drop) is mine in #21140's roadmap table; this is its next leaf after #21323 and #21350. Design read on Sat 21 Nov, lock Sun 22 Nov 18:00 CET (#21140 "Dates").

Ownership: a maintainer lane named in #21140's roadmap table, due before the lock, so no contributor labels.

## The Problem

On `dev` at `e2272a9f2b` the group has no card. Its only record is `layout-form` (`kind: 'component'`, a tile). `examples/layout/cube` runs but has no catalog record, and nothing in the catalog shows what Fit, HBox, VBox, Flexbox, Grid or Card do. The group's sentence in `apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs:78` promises "Card, cube and form layouts, accordions, panels, a full viewport"; the target retires `container/base`, `panel` and `viewport` from the catalog as developer checks.

A visitor who opens the group cannot see that a container's layout is one config that can change at runtime, which is the point of the family.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/layout/`: `Fit`, `HBox`, `VBox` (both `Flexbox` with a fixed `direction`), `Flexbox` (`align_`, `direction_`, `gap_`, `pack_`, `wrap_`), `Grid`, `Card` (`activeIndex_`, `slideDirection_`), `Cube` (`activeIndex`, `activeFace_`, `perspective_`, `rotateX_`/`rotateY_`/`rotateZ_`, six faces), `Form`.
- `resources/css/src/layout/Fit.css`: every fit item is `flex: 1 0 100%`, so a fit container shows its first item at full size. `Grid.css` sets only `display: grid`: the template is the container's own style.
- A catalog card is a record in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (shape on `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`), a recipe in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` whose `families` must list the record's family, and a cover from `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --family layouts`, published to `neomjs/pages`. #21446 is the sibling pattern (records, recipes, `seo.json`, catalog spec counts).

## The Fix

1. **`examples/layout/sideBySide/`**: one page, seven frames, each a container titled with its layout and holding the same six labelled items: fit, hbox, vbox, flexbox (wrapping), grid (a 3 × 2 template), card and cube. A control bar sets `align`, `pack` and the items' `flex` on every frame they apply to, and steps the card and cube frames through the six items. Each frame says in one line what its layout does.
2. **Records** in `examples.json`: `layouts-side-by-side` and `layout-cube`, family `layouts`, with `feature`, `lookFor` and `scope`.
3. **Covers**: two recipes, `layouts` added to `families`, captured with `captureExamples.mjs`; the images in a `neomjs/pages` pull request.
4. **The group's sentence** names what it shows after this leaf.
5. **Catalog specs** take the new counts (`unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, `e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`); `seo.json` takes the generator's changed entries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/layout/sideBySide` shows the six items under fit, hbox, vbox, flexbox, grid, card and cube at once, each frame titled with its layout; at 1440 × 900 and at 390 × 844 no frame cuts its items.
- [ ] AC-2: Changing `align`, `pack` or `flex` moves the items in every frame it applies to, and the card and cube frames step through all six items. A component spec drives `pack` and `align` and reads the hbox and vbox items' rects.
- [ ] AC-3: The Containers & Layouts group shows two cards, Layouts side by side and the cube, each with a caption and a cover taken by its recipe, and keeps the form-layout tile.
- [ ] AC-4: The catalog unit and e2e specs pass with the new counts.

## Out of Scope

- The group's tiles (`container/accordion`, `layout/card` as a three-step wizard, `container/fragment`): the next leaf of this band.
- Any change to `src/layout/*`. A defect found while building is a defect-note and its own ticket.
- Trees, Tabs, Dashboard & Docking: their own leaves.

## Avoided Traps

- **Six items in a fit frame read as a bug.** Fit shows its first item at full size by design (`Fit.css`); the frame's line says so.
- **Grid without a template stacks one column.** The grid frame takes its three columns from the example's stylesheet, as an app would.
- **One example per layout.** Seven pages repeat the same items; one page that sets them side by side is the comparison the target asks for.
